cryptohome: Read VPD value faster and handle newlines better Use vpd_get_value in order to obtain VPD values as this will use a cache or the /sys/firmware/vpd filesystem if available. Note that this also allows the value to be read from the RW VPD which is okay and even desirable for testing. To test, procure a device that has a TPM 1.2 (as TPM 2.0 doen't use the same daemon). Ensure that there is a 64 hex character value for the VPD key stable_device_secret_DO_NOT_SHARE (in either RO or RW VPD). If not, create it as follows: # vpd -i RW_VPD -s stable_device_secret_DO_NOT_SHARE=$(openssl rand -hex 32) && reboot Then verify that cryptohomed is running (the process number can be any number): # status cryptohomed cryptohomed start/running, process 16098 # BUG=None TEST=See description. Change-Id: Ic2dafa76389e2c4dc16ff7a6aa239b30119ed9b6 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1024053 Commit-Ready: Yves Arrouye <drcrash@chromium.org> Tested-by: Yves Arrouye <drcrash@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>

ml: Update seccomp to enable D-Bus registration The recent CL crrev.com/c/1006555 added basic D-Bus connectivity to the ml_service daemon, but didn't update the corresponding seccomp policy files (so ml_service currently can't start up under minijail). This CL expands the seccomp policy files for ml_service to add the extra syscalls used by D-Bus. This fixes the ml_CheckMlProcesses autotest (not enabled by default).
